text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haaappy biiirthdaaaay, El!! As a comrade 
with our eyes on the world, ready to take 
flight across the globe! I've prepared a 
top-tier present for you♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in other words... a 'Trip Around the 
World'!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whaaao!! ...Wait, Pearl-senpai! I'm happy 
and all, but I have a race tomorrow too, 
desu...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no problem at all! Who says you have 
to travel abroad to take a trip around the 
world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Believe more in the possibilities!! Close 
your eyes~ and let your imagination 
expand. Now, El... GOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whooosh... Whooosh... Beautiful beaches, 
yachts coming and going... This is 
Auckland...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Whoosh! The wind blowing from lush beech 
forests... Fjords carved out by 
glaciers...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And a cute kiwi bird!! Kee-kee!! Kee-kee!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Kiwifruit?! But... wow, I feel like I'm in 
New Zealand!!
